title: kerberos: add better autodetection of KRB_ERROR e-data/implement service response time statistics

notes.body: Hmm, I just found that it doesn't work with udp as the strange find_conversation(NO_PORT_B)/conversation_new(NO_PORT2) code (that already existed doesn't seem to work....)

That was added in commit fa01ccd18c08763f444fd88507da7ea579ca5c87 back in 2004.

If you just use find_or_create_conversation() everything works...

commits_data.title: kerberos: implement service response time statistics
commits_data.message:
kerberos: implement service response time statistics

Note this showed that the find_conversation(NO_PORT_B)/conversation_new(NO_PORT2)
magic didn't work for udp.

It's very unlikely that a kdc uses the correct src ip address for udp,
but doesn't use port 88 as source port!

Just using find_or_create_conversation() work in all cases for me:
tcp, udp and also iakerb (within a SMB2 over TCP connection).

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>
